hypothesis: Open-market Form 4 purchases by officers and directors whose trades do not follow a calendar-month habit of three or more years carry drift that survives past the first session after the filing (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012); a long position entered from the second session after the filing adds alpha to the reference book at 2x cost.
universe: US-listed common stocks with a Form 4 open-market purchase event, allowlisted for the US set
signal: Event per issuer per filing date from research/strategy/form4.py build_events. Counted: transaction code P (open-market purchase) on a common-stock line with positive shares and price, by a reporting owner whose relationship includes Officer or Director, with a filing date not before the transaction date. Not counted: code S (sales are read but never become events) and every other code, including A, M, F, G and X; owners who are neither officers nor directors, such as 10% holders. Routine trades are dropped: an owner who traded in the same calendar month in each of the prior 3 years at the same issuer. Entry at the fill of the second session after the filing date; the first-session reaction is not capturable at the next-session fill. Long only. Fills per plan/execution.md.

holdout.rule: the last 3 years, never used for any choice; extend to 25% of the sample if that is longer once the sample start is fixed

open_questions: universe: the plan names no list; every issuer with an event that passes the US-set allowlist is proposed. Confirm the allowlist and any liquidity floor.
holding period: the plan states none; label_horizon_days 21 is a placeholder and the exit rule is open.
sizing: the plan states no position weight, per-name cap or portfolio volatility target.
minimum purchase value: the plan states none; form4.py keeps every aggregated value above zero.
cluster rule: the plan states none; form4.py aggregates the insiders of one issuer on one filing date (n_insiders) and does not require two or more.
variants: the plan names no variants; one proposed. Confirm whether an n_insiders >= 2 cluster variant is wanted (at most 2 trials).
decision.min_net_sharpe: the plan requires the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound above 0 and states no numeric floor; 1e-06 stands for 'above 0'.
decision.min_days: the plan states no minimum evaluation length for the backtest gate; 1 is a placeholder (MinTRL is computed by the harness).
decision.max_drawdown_pct: the plan states no figure for this card; 20 is borrowed from the ETF Trend default and is a placeholder.
split.n_splits: the plan states no walk-forward split count; 2 is the validator minimum.
split.embargo_days: the plan gives no number; 0 is a placeholder.
holdout.start: the plan fixes the holdout as the last 3 years or last 25% of the sample, whichever is longer; the sample start is not set, so 3 years is used.

routine-trade history: form4.py counts a month as habitual from trades in the loaded quarters only, so a history shorter than 3 years marks no one routine; confirm the data start leaves 3 years before the first evaluated event.
sells: form4.py reads code S rows for history but they are never signals; confirm that sales are not used as an exit or a short signal.
